summary.zh: 计费预占新增 admission 列（standard / post_delivery，已有行为 standard），并重建预占更新触发器使该列不可修改。
summary.en: Billing reservations gain an admission column (standard / post_delivery; existing rows are standard), and the reservation update trigger is recreated to freeze it.

verification.zh: 核对 BillingReservation.admission 存在且已有行均为 standard；更新触发器拒绝修改 admission。
verification.en: Check that BillingReservation.admission exists with every existing row standard, and that the update trigger refuses changing it.

verification.zh: 迁移期间保持内部计费路由关闭：触发器删除与重建之间没有更新保护。
verification.en: Keep the internal billing routes off while migrating: there is no update guard between dropping and recreating the trigger.
